topic: descendant selector does not match a compound class
lesson: CORRECTS the earlier 'status line class scoping' lesson, which named the wrong fix: '.ask-answer .ask-period-status' (globals.css:1518) is a DESCENDANT selector, so an element carrying BOTH classes does not match it — measured live, the reopen pending line now computes 12px ink (inherited from .ask-answer alone) where its two sibling status lines are 11px slate. Fix it in CSS, not JSX: extend that rule to '.ask-answer .ask-period-status, .ask-answer.ask-period-status'. Leave ask-panel.tsx:151 exactly as it is.
source: live getComputedStyle on the held-open pending turn at /ask
